Anya CS: Hey team — quick weekly health sync focused on p95/p99 latency by route/model and streaming vs non-streaming. Wanted to surface a couple of anomalies we saw this week.

Mike CSM: TL;DR — usage +12% WoW, spend +8%. Two onboarding accounts (BrightPath, NovaEdge) showing p99 spikes on chat.generate when streaming is enabled.

Raj Onboard: BrightPath details: p95 steady ~260ms, but p99 jumps to ~1.2s at ~30 concurrent streams. Symptoms: higher KV cache miss and occasional 502s.

Lisa Observability: Observed correlation with prefix cache churn. When cache miss rate >22% we see p99 tail blow out. Quick trace sample: `trace_id=abc123` route=chat.generate model=redwood-3b-quant mode=streaming.

Mike CSM: Error surface — ~0.4% 502s during peak p99 windows; not steady but enough to trigger customer complaints.

Anya CS: Risk note — BrightPath renewal in ~6 weeks. If p99 doesn't improve under 800ms we should prepare mitigation offer.

Raj Onboard: Yesterday I lowered max_streams_per_session to 8 for BrightPath — p99 dropped to ~780ms for ~6 hours then drifted back as traffic changed.

Lisa Observability: Recommend two-pronged approach: 1) KV cache pinning for hot prefixes, 2) adaptive batching for streaming paths (finer-grained batch windows). Canary on NovaEdge as control.

Mike CSM: Cost impact? When streaming falls back to non-streaming due to errors we saw ~6% increase in token spend per 1k requests. Need to include in renewal math.

Anya CS: Action items — (1) Eng: try cache-pinning for BrightPath (Raj to coordinate), (2) Ops: schedule canary for batching change tomorrow 09:00 PT (Lisa), (3) CSM: prepare renewal note + remediation plan (Mike).

Raj Onboard: I'll create eng ticket and attach traces + config diff.

Lisa Observability: Traces/queries: https://telemetry.redwood/team/browse/trace/abc123 and sample query `latency_tail(route="chat.generate", model="redwood-3b-quant", mode="streaming")`. Proposing p99 alert at 900ms for this cohort.

redwood-bot: Deploy done: rollout/kv-cache-pinning -> canary on NovaEdge at 2024-06-05T09:00:00Z :thumbsup:

Mike CSM: Please post quick results after the 2-hour canary. If no steady improvement I'll escalate to renewals.

Anya CS: Got it — will reconvene next week same time. :spiral_calendar:
